name: D23 Expo
blurb: The Walt Disney Company's biennial official fan convention in Anaheim, with panels, exhibits and Disney stars across a sprawling show floor.
notes: D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event ran Aug 14-16, 2026 at the Anaheim Convention Center (plus the nearby Honda Center) — confirmed via WebSearch (Hoodline, Disney Tourist Blog, MiceChat) since the official site's recap page (d23.com/ultimatefanevent2026/) doesn't spell out the exact dates in its rendered text. D23 Expo is biennial and no US date beyond 2026 is announced yet. The site does announce a separate new event, 'D23 Asia', debuting at Marina Bay Sands/Sands Expo & Convention Centre, Singapore in 2027 — that is a different event/location from this Anaheim convention and was left out of this file.
